headline: Revenue growth was mixed, with a few firms posting very strong gains while others saw modest or slowing growth.
summary: Coforge led the pack with 53.6% YoY revenue growth and raised its EBIT margin guidance. HCLTech and TCS posted double‑digit growth supported by AI‑related revenue. Infosys trimmed its FY27 revenue outlook and saw only 1.5% YoY growth. Wipro’s revenue grew 9.1% but profit fell 1.9% YoY.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms highlighted AI contributions, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth, HCLTech’s AI revenue at $219 m, and TCS crossing the $3 bn AI revenue mark.
